svg.title: DPDK 26.07 TX done cleanup and MTL PR #1919: a question

text.tspan: DPDK 26.07 TX done cleanup frees an mbuf twice: PR #1919 does not make it worse
does this DPDK fault interact with the direct chain?
the fault was there before the PR, and the PR does not make it worse.

tspan.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

text.tspan: (iavf, ice). MTL PR #1919 head 1d869bab on b8b16cac. The fault is in DPDK and main reaches it too.
The PR does not change the path that reaches it: its diff touches no file in
